boundaries.name: rust_native_representation
boundaries.obligation: Rust Bytes32/Address/ChannelId/u8/u16/u32/u64/usize and polynomial/proof-byte domains must be related to Nat records, including nonzero native ChannelId and native amount below 2^64. NativeWidths is a PI representation predicate, not an extra witness validation step. Serde/derive implementations and exact diagnostic text are not proved.

boundaries.name: full_balance_state_validate_h1
boundaries.obligation: Environment.validateState and stateH1 must refine real BalanceState.validate/h1 over complete ciphertext, key, counter, recipient, registry, counts, accumulator, settled-chain and version state. No validate-success-implies-asset-safety axiom is supplied.

boundaries.name: digest_helper_representation
boundaries.obligation: IMCS/IMCL/IMW2 preimages and imported key/ciphertext digest calls must refine canonical bytes/field representations and actual cryptographic helper computations. This model supplies no globally injective finite hash assumption.

boundaries.name: external_e3
boundaries.obligation: For the standard wrapper, Environment.verifyExternal must refine verify_withdraw_claim with the chosen Regev security level, key, entire ciphertext, u64 amount and proof bytes. Callback success itself is not a decryption theorem here.

boundaries.name: in_circuit_decryption_consumer
boundaries.obligation: For the wrapper skipping E3, the caller must subsequently bind this exact statement and witness to the real withdrawal circuit's decryption, H1/Merkle and nullifier constraints and verify the produced proof; this helper is not automatically invoked by fill_witness.

boundaries.name: l1_close_claim_ledger
boundaries.obligation: Authenticated finalized close identity, one-shot nullifier consumption, recipient/token payout and funded entitlement are L1/caller obligations, not enforced by this native helper. No whole-protocol fund conservation claim is made.

boundaries.name: compiled_source_refinement
boundaries.obligation: Handwritten Lean control-flow and codecs are not a proof of Rust compiler behavior, allocation/panic resource behavior, generated code or a complete project refinement. Test bodies are not translated as production.
